title: Chicken enchilada bake
summary: Chicken enchilada bake is a mexican dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and canned black beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Chicken enchilada bake into even pieces and toss canned black beans with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of canned black beans while you season skinless chicken breast fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken breast fillets and chopped tomatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken enchilada bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Chicken enchilada bake into warm bowls with the juices.
